notes.title: ⚔️ 20,000 Souls Claimed & 25,000+ Cursed Pledges! ⚔️
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, brave wanderers of the shadowed realms! The SmutStone Coven bows to you for braving our demo during the Steam Next Fest. [b]Spectral coins, energy gems, and shards of the void[/b] will be yours to claim when the gates open on the first day.[/p][p][/p][p]And yet, your hunger for darkness grows… we’ve now surpassed [b]25,000+ pledges[/b]! The Coven is humbled by your fervor. We’re sharpening our blades and weaving final enchantments, aiming to unleash this grim tale [b]within a moon’s cycle[/b]—perhaps sooner, if the stars align.[/p][p][/p][p]From the depths of our shadow-forged hearts, we thank you for joining this cursed crusade.[/p][p][b]Prepare for the next glimpse into the abyss[/b], and speak your will in the shadowed forums—your voice shapes this [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330500?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=wish&utm_content=mile"]dark realm[/url] more than you know.[/p][p][/p][p]In darkness and gratitude,  [/p][p]—The SmutStone Coven 🖤[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601774/74db9d31d740c64803263a00062b88799bba2f97.jpg"][/img][/p]
